title: Enhancement: Add MSI and i2c-xiic config for Nexthop platforms
author: domingo-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

Enable MSI (gated by FPGA version) and use i2c-xiic for i2c adapters on nexthop platforms

### Current Behavior

MSI is not enabled by default. Uses polling driver for i2c transactions.

### Proposed Behavior

Enable MSI if available and use interrupt driven i2c-xiic driver for i2c transactions

linkedPullRequests.title: [pddf] Add MSI and i2c-xiic config for Nexthop platforms
linkedPullRequests.author: domingo-nexthop
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it

Instantiate i2c adapters using the i2c-xiic driver (instead of the polling `pddf_custom_fpga_algo`) via PDDF. i2c-xiic has been enabled in https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-linux-kernel/pull/564 via PDDF. The feature is gated on the underlying FPGA version which needs to support MSI. 

Continuation of https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/27437

Resolves #28380

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it

Add the relevant config to enable MSI (gated by FPGA version) and config for i2c channels.
